description:
FILED s473t5c (#1501 round 4, `comp/` CHECK 1).  PRE-EXISTING; this task is a
MEASUREMENT of #266's ruled `no` arm, not a request to re-litigate it.

#266 (DONE s374) made `_bareword_callable_here` three-valued and RULED (DECIDED
s375) that the third value -- `no`, i.e. nothing visible declares this name --
keeps answering CALL, because PCL cannot see every name perl can, and a
measured attempt to answer STRING there turned `next`, `goto again` and
File::Spec's `curdir` into strings (corpus-diff 20 of 111).  "No completion
campaign; interleave on cause lines."  THIS IS A CAUSE LINE.

PROBE (perl 5.40.3 vs ./runpcl), every line a separate divergence:

    sub star (*)  { print "star: [$_[0]]\n" }
    sub star2 (**) { print "star2: [$_[0]][$_[1]]\n" }
    sub id { "id:$_[0]" }
    my $x = NOPE;             perl "NOPE"      PCL dies &main::NOPE
    print NOPE2 . "!";        perl "NOPE2!"    PCL dies
    id(NOPE3);                perl "id:NOPE3"  PCL dies
    star NOPE4;               perl "NOPE4"     PCL dies
    star2 NOPE6, NOPE7;       perl "NOPE6"/"NOPE7"  PCL dies

  The PROTOTYPE is NOT the discriminator, which is the finding that kills the
  narrow fix: with a DECLARED `sub FOO`, perl CALLS it in a `*` slot too --
    sub FOO { 'foo-called' }  star FOO;   perl prints [foo-called]
  -- so `(*)` does not mean "bareword here is a glob name"; it is only the
  classifier's default that differs.  A `*`-slot-keyed fix would therefore be
  a second copy of the classifier with a different answer (rule 11's hard
  stop), and the builtin `*` slots (open/close/stat/print) share that table.

  Two further probed facts for whoever takes it:
  - `star(*FOO)` stringifies as `*main::FOO` in PCL where perl prints
    `GLOB(0x...)` -- the #423/#1638 glob-value-vs-glob-ref family, separate.
  - `star(\*FOO)` is right on both (REF / GLOB(0x...)).

WHAT IT COSTS, measured on the s473t5c tree (after #1681):
  t/comp/proto.t DIFF 78/38 with `aborted-forms:1: Undefined subroutine
  &main::FOO called` -- the file's `sub star (*&)` block at line 500 calls
  `star FOO` where nothing declares FOO.  The abort is inside the file's
  single giant `(p-let ((@array ...)) ...)` top-level form, so it costs the
  remaining **100 of 216 rows** (shortfall 100, the whole of comp/'s
  UNEXPLAINED shortfall after #1681 except parser.t/form_scope.t/decl.t).
  t/comp/fold.t's two aborted forms are the same family:
  `stat(1 ? INSTALL : 0)` -> `Undefined subroutine &main::INSTALL` (the
  bareword survives constant folding in perl), 4 of its 11 fail rows.

STOP-RULE if it is attempted: #266's own measurement is the bar -- corpus-diff
over 111 must stay IDENTICAL and the `next`/`goto LABEL`/`curdir` shapes must
be re-probed, because those are what the `no`-answers-string spelling broke.
subject: An UNDECLARED bareword is CALLED where perl reads it as a string -- `my $x = NOPE;` dies, and it costs t/comp/proto.t its remaining 100 rows (#266's `no` arm, measured)
